scenarios.title: Fernhill Coworking landing page
scenarios.focus: Marketing page: navigation, pricing table, testimonials, contact form.
scenarios.summary: Marketing landing page for a fictional coworking space, with navigation, a hero call to action, a pricing comparison table, testimonials, an FAQ and a tour booking form.
scenarios.scope: Single page. Test it as you would a client page: keyboard, screen reader, visual and code inspection, plus any automated tools you normally use. Each attempt activates a different set of defects, applied when the page loads, so inspect the live DOM in DevTools rather than View Source.

scenarios.title: Larkspur Outdoor product page
scenarios.focus: E-commerce: image gallery, product options, quantity, cart and dialogs.
scenarios.summary: Product detail page for a fictional outdoor gear shop, with an image gallery, color and size options, a quantity stepper, add to cart, a cart dialog, a size guide, specifications, reviews and related products.
scenarios.scope: Single page. Exercise every control: choose options, change the quantity, add to cart, and open and close both dialogs with the keyboard and a screen reader. Also check zoom, reflow and text spacing. Defects are applied when the page loads, so inspect the live DOM in DevTools rather than View Source.

scenarios.title: Cedar Valley Rec Center registration
scenarios.focus: Forms: labels, instructions, validation, error recovery and a review step.
scenarios.summary: Program registration form for a fictional recreation center, with participant, emergency contact and billing details, program choices, a password, inline validation, an error summary and a review step before payment.
scenarios.scope: Single page. Fill in the form wrongly as well as correctly: submit it empty, enter invalid data, recover from the errors and complete the registration. Test with the keyboard and a screen reader, and leave the page idle for a while. Defects are applied when the page loads, so inspect the live DOM in DevTools rather than View Source.
